title: Decision Titan: Test-Time Training for Long-Term Memory in Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.01513v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties

translated_title: Decision Titan：离线强化学习中面向长期记忆的测试时训练
translated_abstract: 长期依赖关系仍然是人工智能领域序贯决策面临的主要挑战：循环神经网络（RNN）受到梯度消失问题以及基于向量的隐藏状态表达能力有限的制约，而基于Transformer的模型则受限于注意力机制的二次方扩展性。近期研究提出利用测试时训练框架来解决这一问题，该框架通过在训练和测试阶段进行梯度下降，将情节记忆存储在神经网络的参数中。这一方法已在自然语言处理领域取得成功，然而据我们所知，它尚未被应用于强化学习（RL）领域，也没有相关研究分析这种记忆的实际运作方式。本文通过在Decision Transformer中增加TTT层（被称为Decision Titan），研究了TTT框架在离线强化学习中的应用潜力。我们对性能和特性进行了分析
tldr: 本文提出Decision Titan，首次将测试时训练（TTT）框架引入离线强化学习领域，通过在Decision Transformer中加入TTT层来实现长期记忆，以克服RNN梯度消失和Transformer注意力二次方扩展的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Decision Titan, which for the first time applies the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework to offline reinforcement learning by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, enabling long-term memory to overcome the vanishing gradient limitations of RNNs and the quadratic scaling of Transformer attention.
